text: On first-run header refresh, Account Hub selects two visual Fluent IDs, adds aria-hidden attribute presence to those spans and unhides a separate complete welcome string with the brand placeable. Subsequent-run reverses those states. The step attribute triggers refresh, while the header samples isFirstRun itself. The source establishes these DOM changes; attribute-presence and visibility tests do not establish actual screen-reader output.
title: Account Hub branding refresh separates split visual text from the complete welcome message
